limitations: The official participant list confirms only company name, country and stand. Website associations come from exact unique stand matches in the official guide; shared-stand links were excluded. Public contacts and Telegram links are shown only when found on an associated company website. Telegram preview coverage varies by channel; up to 10 recent posts were collected per preview. The agenda contains announcements and does not confirm that sessions occurred. Market research results were too noisy to support market-size claims.
